rappel_detail.station: A notch on the south ridge, reached by reversing the summit ridge over the lower first bump.
rappel_detail.notes: One long rappel, reported as roughly 60 m; some parties found a 60 m rope barely reaches the anchor. Below it, bypass steep snow and waterfall-wet rock to the side and downclimb about two more rope-lengths of steep terrain to the lower basin.
hazards: Check that your rope reaches before committing.
In winter and spring parties downclimb the Dry Creek couloir instead, which is insecure and dangerous.

set.rappels: 1 long rappel (reported as about 60 m) from a notch on the south ridge, then about two rope-lengths of steep downclimbing to the lower basin
